title: Bank bond/loan issuances cluster
summary: Bank of Baroda ₹10,000 cr Green Infra Bonds (7.10%, 3x oversubscribed) — **first bank in India** for a domestic green infra bond.

items: Bank of Baroda ₹10,000 cr Green Infra Bonds (7.10%, 3x oversubscribed) — **first bank in India** for a domestic green infra bond.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → BoB's "first bank in India" green-bond claim stands out; don't confuse 7.10%/7.05%/7.24% coupons.
